title: Are the GPUs using the fast link?

scenes.heading: Training finished. What path did it use?
scenes.sub: A completed job can hide a network fallback.
voice: A multi-node training job finishes on your cluster.
Workers can still exchange data if NCCL falls back to sockets, so completion alone leaves the transport in question.

scenes.heading: Run a fabric-specific check
scenes.sub: The recipe tells AICR which check to run.
voice: Run the performance phase for a recipe with the network-specific check.
Its NCCL all-reduce job sends data across the GPU workers and measures bus bandwidth.

scenes.heading: Open the transport result
scenes.sub: The expected transport is part of the verdict.
voice: The check compares bandwidth with the recipe's floor and inspects which transport actually carried traffic.
A supported recipe can fail its fabric check when NCCL reports sockets where it expected RDMA.

scenes.heading: Investigate the network path
scenes.sub: Use the check result to narrow the search.
voice: Use the mismatch to investigate the worker network setup and repeat the same check.
A ready workload and the intended fabric are two separate things to verify.

payoff: See a completed training benchmark fail its fabric check when NCCL falls back to sockets.
